messages:
mike: Heads-up — rolling a config-only deploy in the 11:15-11:45 change window. Changes: routing shaper thresholds (per-tenant QPS), request timeout 8s -> 10s, batch_size cap 64 -> 128, and tightened burst limiter. Plan: 10% canary for 30m, then 50% if clean. Monitor 5xx, p95 latency, cost. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4521. Ping if concerns.

anya: Ack, lgtm. I'll watch latency and the cost dashboard.

chen: @mike can we pin model route to v2.1 in this config? I want a deterministic canary instead of dynamic routing.

mike: Yes — pinning route-model to v2.1 in the rollout. Fallback still set to v2.0 but prefer manual rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy started: config-deploy/4521 -> env=prod, canary=10% (shaper-timeout-batch changes)

linda: Quick ask: canary hold to 30m instead of 20m? cost regressions can be slow to surface. :thinking_face:

mike: Good call. Hold 30m. Updating checklist.

chen: Ops thresholds proposal: if 5xx rate > 0.5% OR p95 latency > 2s for two consecutive 5m windows -> immediate rollback.

oncall-bot: Alert policy attached: 5xx_rate_threshold=0.5% ; p95_latency_threshold=2s. Paging -> @oncall if triggered.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed at 10%. Will auto-promote to 50% at t+30m if no alerts.

anya: t+12m — I see a small 503 spike on route /v1/generate. Kicking off traces now.

chen: Traces show heavy tail on a single inference node, kernel OOM-ish behavior on host ip-10-0-7-114.

mike: Hold the rollout. Initiate rollback plan per runbook. Everyone standby.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated: config-deploy/4521 -> rolling back to config:prod@4520

deploy-bot: rollback complete: config-deploy/4521 rolled back at 1824623578. All canary traffic restored to previous config.

linda: Post-mortem notes: revert batch_size increase for now, open infra ticket for node OOM, add memory guard in runtime. I'll add these to release notes and link infra ticket.

mike: Thanks — action items: (1) infra ticket for host OOM, (2) tighten canary thresholds in the checklist, (3) re-run config-only after infra fix with smaller batch delta.

mike: Closing thread — will follow up in the postmortem doc.
